item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"A correct answer explains that the normal ChatAdapter parser expects marker-delimited output fields such as `[[ ## answer ## ]]`, not bare JSON, and that a plain-JSON completion missing those output-field sections triggers `AdapterParseError` when the required output fields are not recovered.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"A correct answer states that `ChatAdapter.__call__` transparently retries through `JSONAdapter()` after most failures on the chat-format path, but it must also note the strict opt-out: no retry occurs for `ContextWindowExceededError`, when already using `JSONAdapter`, or when `use_json_adapter_fallback=False`.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The program includes a permissive case that feeds a raw-JSON answer into the default `dspy.ChatAdapter()` and asserts that the final parsed result is exactly `[{\"answer\": \"Paris\"}]`, demonstrating the fallback-success path.","span_ids":["s4"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The program includes a strict case that runs the same kind of non-marker completion through `dspy.ChatAdapter(use_json_adapter_fallback=False)` and asserts that it raises `AdapterParseError` rather than invoking JSON fallback.","span_ids":["s3","s5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":117,"end_line":137},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":211,"end_line":246},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":63,"end_line":85},{"span_id":"s4","path":"tests/adapters/test_chat_adapter.py","start_line":457,"end_line":476},{"span_id":"s5","path":"tests/adapters/test_chat_adapter.py","start_line":479,"end_line":494}]}
